description: Connects human genes to Gene Ontology molecular functions through direct NCBI gene2go annotations or annotations propagated to ancestor terms through is_a and part_of relationships.

common_properties.name: qualifier
common_properties.description: Gene2go annotation qualifiers; propagated-only associations use ["inferred"]. Direct annotations take precedence when direct and propagated support overlap.
common_properties.notes: The qualifier and evidence lists are positionally aligned — qualifier[i] corresponds to evidence[i], representing one distinct annotation row from gene2go. Only unique (qualifier, evidence) pairs are stored per edge; duplicates arising from different PubMed support are collapsed.

common_properties.name: evidence
common_properties.description: GO evidence codes from gene2go, such as IDA, IEA, IBA, TAS, and IMP; propagated-only associations use ["inferred"]. Direct annotations take precedence when direct and propagated support overlap.

common_properties.name: unbiased
common_properties.description: Always False: GO annotations are a curated (biased) set.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the edge was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: Human annotations (tax_id = 9606) for genes present in SPOKE. Obsolete GO terms are excluded. Only terms with a final annotated-gene set of 2–1000 genes inclusive are included. NOT annotations are excluded, and a NOT annotation also removes the gene from that term’s propagated associations.
source_contributions.description: Includes all non-NOT qualifiers. Direct annotations retain their qualifier and evidence pairs; associations supported only by ontology propagation carry the "inferred" sentinel in both properties.
